facts.claim: AIDAluna (AIDA Cruises): Entered service 2009; 69,203 GT; 2070 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 252 m length; Sphinx class.
AIDAluna is a Sphinx-class cruise ship, owned by the United States-based Carnival Corp and operated by AIDA Cruises.
AIDAluna initially deployed in the Baltic Sea for the 2009 Summer season.
AIDAluna has an 8-by-4.5-metre poolside theater, which is a first for AIDA Cruises.

catalogSpecs.description: Offers the unique Moonlight Bar and a giant LED screen on the pool deck for open-air movie nights.
